subject: Native sweep 2026-09-02 follow-up: Android/desktop fixes landed as a patch; B5 licence row is stale; one sim-request for the window
body: Fifteen findings from the independent Android/desktop/firmware read are fixed in one patch (worktree at 1cc51b7; not yet on origin). Mac lane owns the two runs that need a machine: artifacts/sim-requests/2026-09-02-android-desktop-first-run.json asks for android-core-tests, desktop-core-tests and the NEW desktop-window-smoke (scripts/mac/desktop-window-smoke.sh). The window one matters: tauri.conf.json never set app.withGlobalTauri, so every launch of the Tauri shell showed the 'Could not read the decision from the core' banner over empty panels while CI stayed green — CI never opens a window. The key is set and a cargo test in main.rs holds it, but only a person looking at the screenshot (SIGNALGRID_DESKTOP_SCREENSHOT=1) can confirm the render; the script says so. Also in the patch: Android GateEndpoint is now a class with the loopback set as a constructor parameter, strict by default (10.0.2.2 refused, matching Rust); app/DeviceGate.kt widens it only when Build.PRODUCT starts with sdk/google_sdk/emulator — I could not compile the app module here (no SDK), so assembleDebug on your side is the first build of that file. Manifest sets usesCleartextTraffic=false explicitly (minSdk 26; the platform default only flipped at 28). Theme follows the device (values-night + isSystemInDarkTheme). Both clients now treat obligations as optional-absent per the served spec (AssistResult has no such field) and render a step_up with none stated as 'step up required; the gate did not state an obligation'; two shared vectors added. LEDGER CORRECTION: your B5 row (Cargo.toml license = UNLICENSED in firmware/dock/core, native/desktop/app, native/desktop/core) is stale — all three say MIT since #373; drop it. firmware.yml ran cargo test twice; now once. Not verified from the cloud: any Android SDK build, any desktop window, cargo test/clippy for native/desktop/app (no webkit2gtk here).
